agreement.title: Credit Card Pre-Authorization User Agreement

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: This agreement applies to credit card pre-authorization services. The pre-authorization you perform through this page is a transaction with the merchant using this system; payment processing is completed through the Stripe account configured by that merchant.

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Agreement
section1.content: Before using this pre-authorization service, please read and fully understand the entire content of this agreement. By checking the consent checkbox and clicking "Confirm and Authorize," you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to all terms of this agreement, and authorize the Merchant to process your credit card pre-authorization and related personal information.

sub1.title: 2.1 Nature of Pre-Authorization
sub1.item1: This service is credit card pre-authorization, not an actual charge. The system will freeze the pre-authorization amount on your credit card as a guarantee.
sub1.item2: During the pre-authorization period, this amount will be temporarily frozen by your bank but will not be charged to your account immediately.
sub1.item3: Actual fees are based on the final order settlement; the system will charge according to the actual consumption amount, and any excess will be automatically released.

sub2.title: 2.2 Purpose of Pre-Authorization
sub2.item1: Pre-authorization serves as an order guarantee to protect the legitimate interests of the Merchant.
sub2.item2: After order completion, settlement will be made based on actual consumption amount.
sub2.item3: If the order is cancelled or no settlement is required, the pre-authorization will be automatically released after the specified period.

sub3.title: 2.3 Payment Processing
sub3.item1: This service processes payment information through the Stripe payment infrastructure.
sub3.item2: Your full credit card number will not be stored by the Merchant; payment data is securely stored and processed by Stripe in its PCI-DSS compliant environment.

section3.title: 3. Your Authorizations
section3.intro: By using this service, you expressly agree and authorize the Merchant to:

item1.title: Pre-Authorization Operation:
item1.content: Execute pre-authorization on your provided credit card and freeze the corresponding amount as guarantee.

item2.title: Information Collection:
item2.content: Collect and store information necessary for completing pre-authorization and compliance, including order details, partial card information, timestamps, IP address, and device information.

item3.title: Electronic Authorization Evidence:
item3.content: Store the above information as electronic authorization evidence to comply with card network requirements for card-not-present pre-authorization.

item4.title: Automatic Release:
item4.content: Automatically initiate pre-authorization release when the pre-authorization expires or the order is completed.

section4.title: 4. Personal Information and Privacy
section4.content: Information collected is used only for pre-authorization processing, order management, security verification, compliance auditing, and legal obligation fulfillment. The Merchant will not sell your personal information to third parties. Payment-related sensitive data is encrypted and stored by Stripe according to industry standards.

item1.title: Normal Release:
item1.content: After the pre-authorization expires, the system will automatically initiate release, and funds will be returned to your credit card's available limit.

item2.title: Early Release:
item2.content: Administrators may manually release when business rules permit.

item3.title: Actual Charge:
item3.content: If the order incurs actual consumption, the actual amount will be charged and the pre-authorization balance will be released accordingly.

section6.title: 6. Risk Notice
section6.item1: Pre-authorization will occupy your credit card's available limit; please ensure sufficient limit.
section6.item2: After pre-authorization release, the fund return time is determined by the card issuer.
section6.item3: For delays or anomalies due to network, banking system, or force majeure, the Merchant will assist to the best of its ability within reasonable scope.

section7.title: 7. Agreement Amendments
section7.content: The Merchant may amend this agreement based on business needs, legal and regulatory changes, or compliance requirements. Amended agreements will be published on this page. Your continued use of the Service constitutes acceptance of the amended agreement.

section8.title: 8. Governing Law
section8.item1: This agreement shall be governed by the laws of Japan.
section8.item2: Disputes arising from this agreement shall be resolved through friendly negotiation; if negotiation fails, the matter shall be submitted to the Tokyo District Court for resolution.

zeroAuth.heading: Zero-Yen Authorization (Credit Guarantee Waiver)
zeroAuth.subheading: In place of a standard authorization, please save your card on file and agree to the special terms.
zeroAuth.intro: This procedure is for customers who prefer not to place a standard authorization (credit hold). The charge is ¥0 (zero-yen authorization): only your card is securely saved, and it is billed later only in the event of an accident or damage.
zeroAuth.feeBoxNote: The amount charged varies by vehicle type and the nature of the damage. You are charged ¥0 at signing / card save. If an accident, damage, scratch, parking violation, speeding, etc. occurs, the loss the Company incurs is billed later.
zeroAuth.todayChargeNote: No actual charge is made when signing and saving the card.
zeroAuth.cardCheckNote: A temporary ¥50 card check is made and released immediately.
zeroAuth.summaryNoChargeNote: Today's actual charge for this procedure is ¥0.
zeroAuth.summaryDamageOnly: Later billing only for accident, damage or violations
zeroAuth.summaryDamageOnlyNote: Only covered events are billed later for the actual loss.
zeroAuth.summaryStripeSecure: Card details are securely stored by Stripe
zeroAuth.summaryStripeSecureNote: The shop does not store the full card number.
zeroAuth.signatureHelper: Sign inside the box with your finger or mouse.
zeroAuth.agreeCheckbox: I agree that the loss the Company incurs from this rental (accidents, damage, scratches, parking / speeding violations, etc.; varies by vehicle) may be charged later.
zeroAuth.contractCreated: The contract has been created and saved.
zeroAuth.sendToPos: Send to POS terminal and save card (zero-yen auth)

zeroAuth.cardSaved: Card saved. It can be billed later when needed.
